hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty' | { read -r f; [ -n "$f" ] && echo "$f" | grep -q '\.go$' && gofmt -w "$f"; } 2>/dev/null || true

jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty' | { read -r f; [ -n "$f" ] && { echo "$f" | grep -q '\.go$' || [ "$(basename "$f")" = "go.mod" ]; } && [ -f go.mod ] && go build ./... 2>&1 | tail -5; } 2>/dev/null || true
